algorithm.title: Suggested Evaluation of the Patient with Suspected Muscular Dystrophy.

cell.label: Duchenne muscular dystrophy suspected (delayed or lost developmental milestones, abnormal posture or gait, muscle weakness or Gowers sign)
Does peripheral blood DNA analysis and/or muscle biopsy staining reveal deficient or defective dystrophin?
Treatment oriented toward general, respiratory, cardiovascular, and musculoskeletal care (see ).
